split_policy.train: categories: official train list, seed-shuffled with seed=42
split_policy.validation: 10% of train stratified by category, fixed split key = 'family_d_v1_mpdd_val'
split_policy.test: official test list, frozen and untouched until execution

selection_rule: validation-only, RGA+ chosen head = argmax_val{rga_meta_router, rga_boosted_fusion}, tie-break boost

inference_rule.delong: Sun&Xu 2014 fast-DeLong on seed-averaged ensemble prediction vectors

decision_rules.CONFIRMED: Holm p<=0.05 AND CI excludes 0 in hypothesized direction AND |delta|>=0.005

what_confirmation_unlocks: phrase 'confirmatory evidence on a held-out benchmark' in abstract
removal of 'audited reanalysis' qualifier from corresponding Family-A claim
what_confirmation_does_not_unlock: ELARA is validated for clinical deployment
Public benchmark results prove broad cross-domain superiority
